verses.text: paul, silas, and timmy on the line—sending this to the Thessalonian squad repping God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
grace to y’all. peace too. straight from the Father and the King.
we gotta thank God for y’all always—it’s only right. your faith’s been bulking up, and your love for each other? off the charts.
so we brag on y’all to the other churches—how y’all stay solid through pressure and pain, still loyal, still locked in.
that’s proof God’s judgment is legit. y’all suffering now, but it’s shaping you to be kingdom-ready. that’s the real win.
‘cause it’s only fair—God’s gonna clap back at the ones who’ve been dragging y’all.
and He’s gonna give y’all rest when He pulls up—us too. the Lord Jesus coming in hot, sky cracked open, angels in full flame mode.
He’s bringing fire for the ops—those who ghosted God and swiped left on the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
they’re catching eternal Ls—cut off from the Lord’s presence, no glory access, just blackout.
but when He shows up, He’s getting max glory from His squad—everyone who believed. and y’all in that number, ‘cause you locked in when we dropped the Word.
that’s why we keep praying for y’all—that God would count you worthy of the call, and power up every good move and faith-fueled plan y’all got.
so the name of our Lord Jesus gets max clout through y’all, and y’all get lifted in Him—‘cause of our God and the grace He dropped through Jesus.
now fam, about the King’s return and us linking up with Him—we gotta talk.
don’t get spooked. no panic texts, no fake prophecies, no forged scrolls saying the Day of the Lord already dropped. that’s cap.
don’t let anyone finesse you. first, there’s gotta be a mass unfollow—the great fall-off. and then the man of sin shows up, the full-on op, son of destruction.
he’s gonna wild out—flexing like he’s God, pulling up in sacred spaces, posting like he’s the Most High. full blasphemy mode.
y’all forgot? we told you this when we were with you. this ain’t new.
and now you know what’s holding him back—there’s a blocker in place, keeping him benched till it’s time.
the mystery of lawlessness is already loading, lowkey. but the restrainer’s still active—until he gets pulled out the way.
then boom—the outlaw gets revealed. but the Lord’s gonna end him with a single breath, delete him with the brightness of His return. no boss fight needed.
this dude’s whole vibe? satan-coded. fake miracles, counterfeit signs, lying wonders—he’s got the dark arts toolkit.
and he’s gonna finesse those who chose the lie over the truth—people who curved the love that could’ve saved them.
so God lets ‘em get hit with strong delusion—since they wanted the lie, they’re gonna eat it.
and all who chose the cap over the truth? they’re locked in for judgment. they picked unrighteousness, and now they’re stuck with it.
but we gotta thank God always for y’all, fam loved by the Lord—‘cause God picked y’all from the jump for salvation, through Spirit-powered holiness and truth-mode belief.
He called y’all through our gospel drop, so you could share in the glory of King Jesus.
so hold the line, fam. stand firm. keep the teachings we handed y’all—whether it was live or in scroll form.
now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God our Father—who loved us and dropped eternal comfort and hope through grace—
pull up and boost your hearts. lock you in with strength for every good move and every Word drop.
fam, one last thing—pray for us. that the Word runs fast, hits hard, and gets the same respect it got with y’all.
and pray we dodge the weirdos and ops—‘cause not everyone’s got faith. some folks just built different… in the worst way.
but the Lord? He’s locked in. He’ll hold y’all down and keep you steady against the enemy’s sneak attacks.
we’re confident in y’all—y’all been doing what we said, and we know you’ll keep it up. no drop-off.
may the Lord guide your hearts into full-on love mode and patient grind mode—just like Christ moved.
now we command y’all, fam, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ: ghost the lazy ones who won’t follow the blueprint we gave. no freeloaders in the feed.
y’all know how we moved when we were with you. we weren’t out here slacking or mooching.
we didn’t eat anyone’s food for free. we clocked in—grinding day and night, no breaks—so we wouldn’t drain y’all.
not ‘cause we had to, but to show y’all how to move. we were setting the template.
remember what we said: if someone won’t work, they don’t eat. period.
we’ve been hearing some of y’all are just floating—no grind, just gossip. moving like NPCs.
to those folks, we say this—straight from the Lord Jesus: chill out, clock in, and earn your own bread.
but y’all, the real ones—don’t get tired of doing good. keep the energy up.
if someone’s ghosting this scroll, mark ‘em. don’t squad up with ‘em till they feel the weight. not to cancel, but to correct.
don’t treat ‘em like ops—treat ‘em like fam who needs a wake-up call.
now may the Lord of peace Himself drop peace on y’all—always, in every way. the Lord be with all of y’all.
this is Paul signing off with my own hand—this is how I sign my scrolls. it’s the real me.
grace be with y’all. King Jesus got you.
